# Intentional boundaries

Soft line
before a hard break  
after a hard break
and its continuation.

Soft line
before a backslash\
after a backslash
and its continuation.

Two backslashes \\
are not a hard break.

Three backslashes \\\
form a hard break
but this continuation does not.

Soft line
before a break<br>
after a break
and its continuation.

Soft line
before a break
<BR />after a break
and its continuation.

> A quoted line
> before a break  
> after a break
> and its continuation.

- A list line
  before a break\
  after a break
  and its continuation.
